# Frozen historical schema-2 fixture

`engine.py` and `sqlite_engine.py` are exact copies from repository commit
`2756e40ce32f28cc4a5e6cc8d691c3c1cd4eea44` (the parent of `7ad21f1`).
They are run only in an isolated subprocess against synthetic temporary data to
